name: Zeenat Potia
reason: Own site zeenatpotia.com read (robots allows): it presents 'Meditation Mentoring & IFS Counseling' (Internal Family Systems is psychotherapy), its mindfulness page sells the practice on stress, anxiety, depression, pain and insomnia, and the dharma.org bio frames her work around 12-step recovery and healing trauma. Mainly therapy and condition-framed, and only one services page, so skipped (health rule and too thin).
